# Trishala Laminates

> Trishala Laminates (Trishala Laminates Private Limited) is a flexible packaging manufacturer based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India. It makes printed laminate rolls, laminated pouches (stand-up, zipper, spout, centre seal, pillow and gusset pouches) and polyethylene (PE) blown film for food, FMCG, agriculture, pet food, household and industrial brands.

Key facts:

- Founded: 2011, with roots in the flexible packaging industry since 2003
- Production: 800+ metric tonnes per month
- Facility: 1,00,000+ sq ft manufacturing unit at Tuniki Bollaram, Telangana 502279, India
- Corporate office: Plot No. 16/A, IDA Nacharam Road No. 9, IDA Nacharam, Hyderabad, Telangana 500076, India
- Team: 250+ skilled people
- Contact: +91 93910 02657, naman@trishalalaminates.in
- Website: https://www.trishalalaminates.in

## What Trishala makes

- Printed laminate rolls (roll stock) for automatic form-fill-seal packing machines
- Laminated pouches: stand-up pouches, zipper pouches, spout pouches, centre seal pouches, pillow pouches, gusset pouches
- Pouch sizes: 80–300 mm wide, 100–450 mm long, up to 300 pouches per minute
- Multilayer laminate structures: PET/PE, BOPP/PE, PET/MET PET/PE, PET/ALU foil/PE, BOPP/MET BOPP/PE
- PE blown film: up to 1600 mm wide, 25–200 microns, up to 6 MT per day

## Manufacturing capabilities

- Rotogravure printing: 3 presses (9, 9 and 8 colours), up to 1300 mm film width, up to 450 m/min
- Solvent-based lamination: up to 1300 mm, up to 120 m/min
- Solventless lamination: up to 1300 mm, up to 400 m/min
- Extrusion lamination: up to 1300 mm, up to 300 m/min
- Combi lamination (solvent-based and solventless): up to 1300 mm, up to 300 m/min
- Pouch conversion: up to 600 mm film width, up to 300 pouches/min
- PE blown film extrusion: up to 1600 mm, up to 250 kg/hr
- In-house quality laboratory: tensile tester, coefficient of friction tester, vacuum leak tester, hot air oven, colour matching cabinet; tests seal strength, adhesion, barrier, print quality and material integrity

## Industries served

- [FMCG packaging](https://www.trishalalaminates.in/industries/fmcg): food and beverages, household and cleaning products, handwash, chocolates
- [Agriculture packaging](https://www.trishalalaminates.in/industries/agriculture): fertilizers, pesticides, insecticides, seeds, crop medicines
- [Snack packaging](https://www.trishalalaminates.in/industries/snacks): potato chips, banana chips, namkeen, extruded snacks, popcorn
- [Spices and seasonings packaging](https://www.trishalalaminates.in/industries/spices-and-seasonings): turmeric, chilli powder, masala, pepper
- [Tea and coffee packaging](https://www.trishalalaminates.in/industries/tea-and-coffee): tea leaves, premixes, coffee powder and beans
- [Dry fruits and nuts packaging](https://www.trishalalaminates.in/industries/dry-fruits-and-nuts): almonds, cashews, pistachios, raisins
- [Household and cleaning packaging](https://www.trishalalaminates.in/industries/household-and-cleaning): detergents, dishwash, floor cleaners
- [Pet food packaging](https://www.trishalalaminates.in/industries/pet-food): dry food, wet food, treats
